title: Matrix varieties over $S_7$: dimension-three stability and continuum-sized subvariety intervals
summary: We study matrix semirings over the three-element flat additively idempotent semiring with elements one, a, and infinity, where the square of a is infinity. We determine the associated matrix-variety chain completely. The scalar, two-by-two, and three-by-three cases generate three distinct varieties, while every matrix dimension at least three generates the same variety. The proof shows that every failure of an identity in arbitrary dimension is already witnessed on three indices, and it yields a coordinate criterion for all identities in the stable variety.
